question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act (S 629)
bill_title: Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill revises the Emergency Conservation Program and the Emergency Forest Restoration Program to expand eligibility for payments to agricultural producers and owners of forest land impacted by natural disasters. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Farm, Food, and National Security Act (H R 7567)
bill_title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026
plain_language: This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies Department of Agriculture programs (the farm bill), including commodity support, conservation, nutrition assistance, farm credit, rural development, forestry, and crop insurance. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — Farm, Food, and National Security Act (H R 7567)
bill_title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026
plain_language: H.R. 7567 (Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026) reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies Department of Agriculture programs (the farm bill), including commodity support, conservation, nutrition assistance, farm credit, rural development, forestry, and crop insurance. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7567)
bill_title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026
plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7567 (Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026) is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment removes certain emissions standards on farm equipment.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.
